source_bank.title: Retrieval-augmented generation for natural language processing: a survey
source_bank.bounded_use: RAG already comprises distinct retrieval, fusion, generation, evaluation, and graph-based retrieval components; multi-stage architecture is conventional.

source_bank.title: A Survey on Retrieval-Augmented Text Generation for Large Language Models
source_bank.bounded_use: RAG is commonly decomposed into pre-retrieval, retrieval, post-retrieval, and generation stages.

source_bank.title: A review of ontology based query expansion
source_bank.bounded_use: Ontologies can expand and disambiguate queries rather than only narrow candidate spaces.

source_bank.title: An empirical analysis of ontology-based query expansion for learning resource searches using MERLOT and the Gene ontology
source_bank.bounded_use: Ontology-based query expansion can increase coverage/novelty of retrieved objects at comparable precision.

source_bank.title: The use of MMR, diversity-based reranking for reordering documents and producing summaries
source_bank.bounded_use: Redundancy-versus-relevance is an established retrieval problem; MMR explicitly attempts to reduce redundancy while preserving relevance.

source_bank.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
source_bank.bounded_use: Presence in a context window does not guarantee effective use; position and context size can materially change performance.

source_bank.title: Entity Linking
source_bank.bounded_use: Mention detection, candidate selection, identifiers, and disambiguation are established machinery for mapping surface names to canonical entities.

source_bank.title: Machine Learning with a Reject Option: A survey
source_bank.bounded_use: Abstention/rejection is an established machine-learning architecture; selective non-emission is not a novel primitive.

source_bank.title: PRCS-A Ordering Scab Assay v0.4
source_bank.bounded_use: The five-stage PRCS-A order already has zero intrinsic novelty credit and is retained only as a typed factorization hypothesis requiring witnesses/interventions.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Eclipse–Omega is a boundary-defined passive recursive containment system with selective admissibility and is best classified as a governed containment architecture.
claim_matrix.repair: Treat PRCS-A as a project-specific diagnostic architecture or factorization hypothesis, not a discovered general system class.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Internal state, observable state, and registered event are structurally non-identical: S != O != E.
claim_matrix.repair: Use typed spaces and maps: S_t in state space, O_t=P(S_t) in observation space, E_t=R(O_t, policy, metadata) in event space. The meaningful questions are information loss, collisions, and registration policy, not inequality between differently typed objects.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: The projection map P:S->O is lossy and non-injective.
claim_matrix.repair: Demonstrate non-injectivity per implementation with a collision witness s1 != s2 and P(s1)=P(s2), or estimate information loss. Do not assume all projections are non-injective on every restricted domain.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Event admissibility is a first-class operator with registered, latent, suppressed, and aliased states.
claim_matrix.repair: Retain the four-way taxonomy only when each state has a witness rule. Latent requires evidence of an internal candidate; suppressed requires an explicit reject/policy decision; aliased requires demonstrated identity/classification error. Otherwise those states are observationally confounded.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Capacity is a first-class operator governing compute, latency, token budget, and attention sparsity.
claim_matrix.repair: Keep capacity explicit only when kappa is measured and interventions on capacity produce source-bound changes. No novelty credit.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: D superset C_k(q) superset C_kappa(q) superset C_B(q) superset E(q).
claim_matrix.repair: Nested subset notation is type-safe only while all stages select elements from the same document universe. Use D >= C_k >= C_kappa >= C_B only for selection stages that really are subsets. Then switch codomains: Y~p(.|q,C_B), followed by a registration/release map to E. Generated text or event objects are not generally subsets of document sets.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: At each stage, available state narrows.
claim_matrix.repair: Model stages as transformations that may contract, expand, preserve cardinality, or reweight. Record stage-specific changes in candidate count, entropy/diversity, coverage, and support instead of assuming monotone set inclusion.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Ontology functions less as liberation than containment by constraining allowable closure.
claim_matrix.repair: Use ontology-conditioned candidate transformation. Depending implementation, ontology can narrow, expand, disambiguate, connect, or reweight retrieval paths. Containment is one possible effect, not the ontology's general function.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Valid geometry plus bounces=0 shows internal propagation/interaction can occur without registered bounce-events.
claim_matrix.repair: A zero registered-event count establishes R=0. It does not identify whether latent interaction I was 0 or 1. Preserve two observationally compatible worlds until an internal trace, intermediate witness, or intervention distinguishes them.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Naming is operational rather than cosmetic; glyph/name changes can alter routing.
claim_matrix.repair: Within TD613, dash states may be declared protocol states. Generalize only when an implementation actually branches, retrieves, or classifies differently. A glyph difference alone does not create a route difference. Keep Jaccard retrieval sensitivity as an empirical assay, not proof from punctuation.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Anti-equivalence lines in the textual corpus are formal constraints and operating code.
claim_matrix.repair: Call them normative/semantic constraints unless bound to a parser, rule engine, prompt contract with tested compliance, or machine-enforced validator. TEXTUAL_REFUSAL != EXECUTABLE_CONSTRAINT.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Moiré images demonstrate projection-induced coherence/false motion and model analogous AI answer surfaces.
claim_matrix.repair: Retain moiré as visualization/analogy where source-domain structure is mapped explicitly. It does not establish the mechanics of a retrieval system. Reuse the prior analogy-fidelity and source-bound moiré assays rather than back-projecting physical claims.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: 3=(sqrt(3))^2 formalizes a meaningful extension-closure pair and systemic hinge.
claim_matrix.repair: Keep sqrt(3) only where forced by equilateral geometry. Remove it from the scientific argument for retrieval/admissibility unless a separately derived operator depends on that extension.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Rupture occurs when an admissible extension cannot be uniquely reclosed into the governing ontology.
claim_matrix.repair: Retain only as a project-defined failure predicate if admission and closure operators are independently measurable. Do not infer a universal rupture law from the definition.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Average pairwise embedding cosine measures semantic redundancy of retrieved candidates.
claim_matrix.repair: Pairwise similarity is a legitimate operational redundancy measure, but not a new construct. Compare it against MMR/diversity metrics and duplicate-aware controls.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Retrieval-observability deficit increasing implies semantic redundancy increases.
claim_matrix.repair: Define the deficit independently, preregister direction, and test across retrieval policies. Relevance-only selection can create redundancy, but the claimed monotone relation is not established.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Retrieval/generation creates new surfaces but no new source information internally.
claim_matrix.repair: Use NO_NEW_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_FROM_GENERATION. A model may derive or compose propositions not explicitly present in a source while still adding no new independent external evidence. Do not collapse derivational novelty into evidentiary novelty.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Repeated defects reveal the apparatus and can function as route signatures.
claim_matrix.repair: Repeated anomalies can motivate localization, but source duplication, shared preprocessing, model bias, or correlated inputs are competing causes. Treat recurrence as a diagnostic feature, not provenance or causation by itself.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: The right term for the bounded user-facing output is controlled reality surface.
claim_matrix.repair: Retain controlled reality surface as a critical/governance project term if useful, but define it operationally and do not treat the phrase itself as a scientific contribution.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Admissibility capture is systematic exclusion, suppression, or aliasing of internally available states from the projected surface.
claim_matrix.repair: Use only when an upstream candidate is independently evidenced and a downstream loss or reclassification can be localized to a measured stage. Otherwise 'capture' overstates what the observation identifies.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Consensus can be manufactured by recurrence/narrowing when redundant evidence fills the context.
claim_matrix.repair: A narrow/redundant result set can reduce exposure diversity and inflate apparent support counts. User-perceived consensus is a separate psychological outcome that requires empirical study.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: Advanced ontology-based retrieval systems are principally engines of enclosure, routing, capacity-conditioned compression, approximation, and selective ratification rather than answer production.
claim_matrix.repair: Describe the technical object as a multi-stage candidate transformation, evidence selection, generation, and release pipeline. 'Enclosure' can remain a critical interpretation when a measured implementation demonstrably reduces reachable/visible evidence.

claim_matrix.paper_claim: If valid interaction can coexist with zero registered events, absence from the ledger is not equivalent to absence from the system.
claim_matrix.repair: Absence from the ledger establishes only absence of a recorded event. Internal interaction remains unresolved unless separately witnessed. If interaction is independently proven, then ledger absence and interaction can be shown to diverge.

provenance_boundary.rule: An idea may be conventional while a distinctive expression or exact borrowed formulation still has provenance significance; conversely, overlap in standard pipeline structure is weak copying evidence without chronology/access/textual similarity.

retained_research_program: Typed state->observation->registration accounting with explicit witness rules
Stage-localization experiments for candidate loss, policy rejection, naming sensitivity, and registration
Empirical name-variant retrieval sensitivity rather than dash ontology generalization
Redundancy/diversity experiments under controlled capacity and retrieval policy
Controlled reality surface retained only as an operationally defined critical/governance term
Admissibility capture retained only with upstream-candidate and downstream-loss witnesses
next_attacks: Compile the paper into a typed claim graph and remove every cross-domain analogy edge that lacks an explicit source/target operator map
Run a source-bound stage-collapse assay on actual Aperture/RAG fixtures to test whether separating capacity, projection, policy, naming, and registration improves held-out diagnosis
Run zero-bounce twin-world control: identical registered count with and without independently instrumented interaction
Run name-sensitivity tests across canonical/safe/invalid dash variants against an actual retriever and a normalization control
Run redundancy-versus-diversity intervention under fixed query and capacity using relevance-only versus MMR/diversity-aware selection
If a Snodgrass comparison artifact is later admitted, evaluate chronology, access, exact expression, notation, and uncommon error structure separately from conceptual novelty
